build_mujoco_mpc_package: build the mujoco_mpc python package with setuptools including proto compilation and CMake extension
generate_proto_grpc_files: generate direct_pb2 and direct_pb2_grpc python files from direct.proto using grpc_tools.protoc
copy_direct_server_binary: copy the compiled direct_server C++ gRPC binary into the python build directory
copy_task_assets: copy mujoco task XML assets from mjpc/tasks into the python package build directory
configure_cmake_build: configure and build the direct_server C++ extension with CMake using platform-specific architecture flags
